name: codex-stackchan-bridge
description: Repo-local Codex plugin for setting up, developing, validating, and operating the local StackChan bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Set up, develop, and validate the local StackChan bridge.
interface.longDescription: Repo-local Codex plugin for codex-stackchan-bridge. It provides workflows for setting up local and hardware environments, routing repository development work, handling command-contract changes, and choosing quality gates while preserving the project boundaries around stackchanctl, ROS 2, micro-ROS firmware, local TTS, mock backends, redaction, and firmware-owned safety.
defaultPrompt: Set up codex-stackchan-bridge locally with mock checks.
Plan a codex-stackchan-bridge change using repo guidance.
Choose the right validation gates before pushing.
